content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the kaunas district court the court decided to dissolve a marriage and awarded the applicant a vehicle however the applicant is required to pay the defendant a compensation of €500 the court discussed the division of matrimonial property and recognized the personal property of the parties involved the court also ordered the defendant to refund excess stamp duty and pay the proceedings costs the court determined that a hyundai car belongs to the defendant and a daimler chrysler vehicle belongs to the applicant the defendant objected to the division of property but evidence showed that the hyundai car was purchased before the marriage and sold by the defendant the court upheld the action to annul the marriage registration record and ordered the defendant to pay the costs the applicant paid a stamp duty and requested reimbursement of the overpayment the court determined the payable stamp duty and ordered the state tax inspectorate to reimburse the overpaid amount
